Author: Meowmeowmeow Cat
Name: FPSBooster
Description: A performance-focused plugin that reduces unnecessary rendering work. The Housing tab manages housing-furniture culling. The Players and NPCs tabs provide read-only diagnostics for character object counts, draw objects, skeletons, loaded model slots, visibility state, and the game's drawable-object limit. Character visibility changes are not enabled yet. Commands: /fpsbooster, /fpsbooster on, /fpsbooster off.
Punchline: Reduce unnecessary rendering work for smoother gameplay.
